postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Posten Bring postcode-register row establishes the four-digit postcode, postal place, municipality reference and current G, P, B or S function category at the register's effective time. Syntax, locality, address point, municipality or polygon alone does not establish current operator assignment or delivery eligibility.
postal_system.category_rule: G is used for street addresses, P for post-office boxes, B for both street addresses and post-office boxes, and S for special service not used as an ordinary address. Category and validity are retained; no area is invented for a P or S code or for an unmatched code.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Kartverket Postnummerområder is the official areal extent of postcodes in its pinned release. Post-office-box codes are additional, and every area keeps code, source feature identity, release/reference time, licence, topology, coverage and lineage. Municipality polygons, buffers, nearest points and Voronoi cells never substitute for a missing official postcode feature.
postal_system.address_rule: Matrikkelen - Adresse supplies official address identity, public components, postcode-district membership and address point. An address can refer to a building, building part, dwelling unit, property or another object; an address point is not a building footprint, dwelling unit, occupant or delivery guarantee.
postal_system.unit_rule: Matrikkelen - Adresse Leilighetsnivå may add a dwelling-unit number. AddressId plus bruksenhetId, or their corresponding UUIDs, form composite unit identity when both exist; this is not occupant, recipient, household or ownership identity.
postal_system.building_point_rule: Matrikkelen - Bygningspunkt supplies building number, type, status, representation point and public address/property link identifiers. A representation point is not footprint geometry and does not prove address containment by itself.
postal_system.building_footprint_rule: FKB-Bygning provides detailed building geometry and a documented 1:1 link to Matrikkelen by building number, but its Norge digitalt/private-purchase access and redistribution terms are separately pinned. Exact footprint output requires that authoritative building-number link and a licensed source release; proximity, point containment and address text are candidate evidence only.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Kartverket official county and municipality units provide names, codes, hierarchy and geometry. Administrative polygons supply context and validation only and do not create postcode assignment, postal-area geometry, category, delivery eligibility or sovereignty conclusions.
postal_system.api_rule: Kartverket's public Address REST API supports individual official-address lookup. Large refreshes use pinned Geonorge distributions; an API convenience response is not a new authority, building footprint, bulk-extraction licence or current Posten assignment unless the underlying source and validity are retained.
postal_system.licence_rule: Each Postnummerområder, Matrikkelen and administrative distribution pins its exact CC BY 4.0 metadata, provider attribution, source URL, download time, reference/release time, schema, CRS, reviewed transform, coverage, digest and AGID changes. NLOD is not assumed merely because a source is public. Posten and FKB artifacts remain separately partitioned under their exact terms.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every geometry retains its source CRS and exact dataset metadata. WGS84 API output records the reviewed transform and version; coordinates are never relabelled without transformation.
postal_system.territory_rule: Every artifact states whether it covers mainland Norway, Svalbard or Jan Mayen. Posten's county-like codes 21 and 22 are operational classifications, not ordinary counties or permission to silently merge ISO SJ records into NO. Source coverage is not a sovereignty determination.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> pinned official Kartverket postcode area or explicit non-area -> Matrikkelen address point -> optional dwelling-unit identity -> building number and representation point -> separately licensed FKB footprint -> NO AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical four digits -> pinned Posten assignment and category -> matching official Kartverket area or explicit non-area -> Matrikkelen addresses -> building-number relation -> licensed FKB footprint -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: official address/building identifier path and, for footprint output, a licensed FKB feature joined 1:1 by Matrikkelen building number

quality_gates.pass: Every postcode remains four-character text and preserves leading zeroes.
Every current assignment pins Posten register version/effective time, postal place, municipality reference, G/P/B/S category, terms, schema and digest.
Area output is an exact pinned Postnummerområder feature under CC BY 4.0; post-office-box, special and absent features remain explicit non-areas.
Every address pins Matrikkelen address ID, public components, point, postcode-district membership, source version, licence, schema, CRS and digest.
Unit display requires addressId plus bruksenhetId or corresponding UUIDs and never exposes an occupant, recipient or household.
Building identity uses a pinned Matrikkelen building number and explicit address linkage; a point, text or proximity match does not pass.
Footprint output pins the exact FKB access/licence and joins 1:1 by building number; private purchase or Norge digitalt conditions remain enforceable.
Mainland Norway, Svalbard and Jan Mayen coverage is explicit and ISO NO/SJ records are never silently merged.
No recipient, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal contact, title/value record, credential, shipment or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete Posten four-digit assignment and G/P/B/S denominator is usable under reviewed AGID processing and public-serving terms and reconciled to a pinned current Kartverket Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon release under CC BY 4.0. Edition, effective date, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, CRS, topology, coverage, exclusions, territory handling and reproducible transformation are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. The real NO API/app normalizes NNNN, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders a translucent fill with clear outline and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; P/O-box, special and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas and no municipality, point, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.
Matrikkelen address, dwelling-unit and building-point releases pass identifier, public-field, licence, privacy, CRS, coverage and correction gates.
Separately licensed FKB footprints pass access, redistribution, 1:1 building-number linkage, geometry and quality gates.
